summary: postinstall downloads and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall hook runs platform-bootstrap.mjs, which fetches a platform tarball via https.get from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at 218.90.133.98:4443 (path /onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz) with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling certificate verification. The tarball is extracted into node_modules, the extracted binary is chmod 0755 and hardlinked as bin/.onecode, and no hash or signature verification is performed. The download base is not a publisher-owned domain associated with the @onescience scope; it is a bare IPv4 address. An ONECODE_TGZ_DOWNLOAD_BASE environment variable can override the base URL, allowing redirection to arbitrary infrastructure while cert checks remain disabled. Any on-path attacker or the operator of the IP can deliver arbitrary native code that becomes the package's CLI binary and executes when the installed tool is run.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
